description_en: Performs a CNAME resolution check on an accelerated domain name to determine whether the CNAME configuration is complete
description_zh: 调用接口对加速域名 Cname 进行解析检测，查看解析结果判断是否完成Cname配置
name: DescribeDomainCname

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names to query. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 domain names in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的加速域名，多个用逗号（,）分隔，单次查询最多支持30个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

Data.description_en: The array of CNAME check results

Cname.description_en: The CNAME assigned to the domain name by Content Delivery Network (CDN)

Domain.description_en: The accelerated domain name specified in the input parameters
Domain.description_zh: 输入参数中的加速域名

ErrMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the CNAME assigned to the domain name does not pass the DNS resolution check or the check times out
ErrMsg.description_zh: 通过域名解析检测到分配给域名的cname不通过或超时的错误信息

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the CNAME assigned to the domain name passed the DNS resolution check. Valid values:
true: Passed.
false: Not passed.
timeout: Timed out
Passed.description_zh:
通过域名解析检测到分配给域名的cname是否通过，取值：
true: 通过
false: 不通过
timeout: 超时

Status.description_en:
The CNAME check result. Valid values:

0: The CNAME assigned to the domain name is detected through DNS resolution.
1: The CNAME assigned to the domain name is not yet detected through DNS resolution.
-1: The detection of the CNAME assigned to the domain name through DNS resolution timed out
Status.description_zh:
Cname检查结果。取值：

0 表示通过域名解析检测到分配给域名的cname。
1 表示通过域名解析暂未监测到分配给域名的cname。
-1 表示通过域名解析检测到分配给域名的cname超时
